description:
Hiring For C2H opportunity, Payroll: Crown Solutions 
 Looking for immediate to 15 days joiners, 
 Interested Candidates can reach out to "harshita@crownsolution.com" or connect to "9590939097" 
 ServiceNow Architect Platform, CMDB, Integrations & Virtual Agent Job Title: ServiceNow Architect
 Experience: 10-18 Years
 Location: Bengaluru / Hybrid
 
 Job Description We are looking for a strong ServiceNow Architect with deep experience in platform architecture, CMDB/CSDM, enterprise integrations, Service Catalog, and Virtual Agent. The ideal candidate will own technical architecture, modernization initiatives, roadmap, and governance while working closely with customer and business stakeholders. 
 Key Responsibilities Lead ServiceNow platform architecture and define scalable technical solutions. Design and govern CMDB/CSDM architecture , including CI relationships, Discovery, Service Mapping, and CMDB governance. Define integration architecture across ServiceNow and enterprise applications. Design Service Catalog and self-service architecture , including catalog items, record producers, workflows, and request management. Implement and architect ServiceNow Virtual Agent , including conversational workflows and NLU/NLP capabilities. Design and manage Entra ID / Active Directory integrations with ServiceNow. Define and maintain the technical roadmap, architecture standards, and governance framework . Lead ServiceNow modernization and transformation initiatives. Work directly with customer stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into robust technical architectures. Provide technical leadership to development and implementation teams and ensure adherence to ServiceNow best practices. 
 Required Skills Strong experience in ServiceNow platform architecture and solution design. Hands-on expertise in CMDB, CSDM, Discovery, Service Mapping, CI relationships, and CMDB governance . Strong understanding of Service Catalog architecture , catalog items, record producers, workflows, and request management. Experience with REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, MID Server, OAuth , and enterprise application integrations. Experience implementing ServiceNow Virtual Agent , NLU/NLP, and conversational workflows. Experience with Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory integrations . Strong understanding of ServiceNow modernization, governance, architecture standards, and technical roadmaps. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. Ability to lead architecture discussions and present solutions to senior customer stakeholders. 
 Preferred Qualifications ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) . ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) or relevant implementation/architect certifications. ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or Certified Master Architect (CMA) is a strong advantage. Experience working on large-scale enterprise ServiceNow transformation programs. 
 What Were Looking For The ideal candidate is not just a ServiceNow developer . We are looking for someone who has owned architecture and technical direction someone who can design the platform, lead CMDB/CSDM strategy, define enterprise integrations, modernize ServiceNow, establish governance, and work directly with customers to drive technical decisions.

Key Skills: Integration,CMDB,Virtual Agent,Service Catalog,Architecture,Servicenow,Catalog
